title: A model for evaluating programs to promote pro-environmental attitudes and behavior
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00880H, Paper

Many educational programs seek to promote students' pro-environmental attitudes and behaviors, yet few are explicitly designed or examined in light of evidence-based design features known to support such change.
